summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes opaque obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a React chatbot UI library but declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) whose contents are obfuscated with `_0x`-prefixed identifiers and string-dictionary lookups. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<archive>.zip`, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB blob prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing string-array rotation and constant-table obfuscation; it is only executable under the fetched Bun runtime and is inert under Node, defeating Node-based inspection. The payload name (`math_init`) has no relation to the declared React UI purpose, and neither the runtime fetch nor the payload contents are described in the package's advertised functionality. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE shape: install-time code fetches an alternate runtime and hands it an opaque bundled blob to execute on the installer's host, hidden from Node-based supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
